transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for making time for this finalization huddle. As you know, we've got the Ash Harbor Mara Quill callbacks coming up on June 18 at Studio 4, 9 AM to 1 PM. The draft package includes the North Wall excerpt, an optional movement exercise, and recorded auditions for internal review. Before I issue the final call sheet, I need each of your sign-offs — counsel, stunt, dialect, and studio scheduling. Let's walk through the plan and surface any concerns so we can lock this down today.
